programme.title: iShowSpeed Meets Tony LC SIGN
programme.desc: IShowSpeed meets Tony LC Sign, one of China’s most recognizable internet personalities, for a unique cultural crossover. As the two connect, explore, and interact, the encounter creates a blend of humor, unexpected moments, and genuine cultural exchange. Combining Speed’s signature energy with Tony LC Sign’s larger-than-life presence, the episode captures an unforgettable meeting between two internet worlds.

programme.title: iShowSpeed Explores Inside The Pyramids Of Egypt!
programme.desc: IShowSpeed ventures inside the pyramids of Egypt, experiencing one of the world’s most iconic landmarks from within. Walking through ancient corridors and hidden chambers, Speed reacts in real time to the history, scale, and mystery surrounding him. Blending curiosity, awe, and his signature energy, the episode captures a rare, up-close perspective of exploring the pyramids in a way few ever get to experience.

programme.title: iShowSpeed & Zac Wang Recreate Karate Kid Scenes!
programme.desc: IShowSpeed teams up with Zac Wang to recreate some of the most iconic scenes from The Karate Kid while exploring the world of martial arts in China. From legendary training exercises to cinematic recreations inspired by the classic film, the duo puts their skills, discipline, and determination to the test. Blending action, comedy, and cultural discovery, the episode captures an unforgettable adventure as Speed steps into the role of a real-life Karate Kid.

programme.title: iShowSpeed Becomes a Mongolian Wrestler!
programme.desc: IShowSpeed steps into the world of Mongolian wrestling, one of the country’s oldest and most celebrated traditions. Training alongside local wrestlers and learning the techniques, discipline, and culture behind the sport, Speed takes on a challenge unlike anything he’s experienced before. Blending competition, cultural discovery, and his signature chaos, the episode captures an unforgettable journey as Speed attempts to earn his place in one of Mongolia’s most iconic athletic traditions.

programme.title: iShowSpeed Discovers Mongolian Throat Singing
programme.desc: IShowSpeed experiences the ancient art of Mongolian throat singing, immersing himself in one of the country's most unique and celebrated cultural traditions. Guided by talented local performers, Speed learns how singers produce multiple tones at once while discovering the history and significance of this centuries-old musical practice. From hilarious attempts to master the technique to unforgettable performances, the episode blends cultural discovery, entertainment, and Speed's signature energy, offering a rare look into one of Mongolia's most extraordinary artistic traditions.

programme.title: iShowSpeed Test Drives Chinese Luxury Cars!
programme.desc: IShowSpeed gets behind the wheel of some of China’s most impressive luxury vehicles, experiencing cutting-edge technology, performance, and design firsthand. From high-speed acceleration and futuristic features to exploring the innovations driving China’s automotive industry, Speed dives into a world of luxury and engineering unlike anything he’s seen before. Blending excitement, discovery, and his signature reactions, the episode captures an unforgettable ride through the future of automotive excellence.

programme.title: iShowSpeed Goes SHARK DIVING In The Bahamas!
programme.desc: IShowSpeed takes on one of his most intense experiences yet as he goes shark diving in the crystal-clear waters of the Bahamas. Coming face-to-face with some of the ocean’s most powerful predators, Speed pushes past his fears and experiences the thrill of the underwater world firsthand. Blending adrenaline, adventure, and his signature chaos, the episode captures an unforgettable journey through one of the Caribbean’s most breathtaking marine environments.

programme.title: iShowSpeed China & Mongolia Moments!
programme.desc: Relive the funniest moments from Speed's unforgettable adventure across China and Mongolia.

programme.title: iShowSpeed Celebrates New Years In South Africa!
programme.desc: IShowSpeed rings in the New Year in South Africa, experiencing the energy of Cape Town for the very first time. From fireworks and citywide celebrations to exploring the streets, culture, and coastline, Speed dives headfirst into everything Cape Town has to offer. It’s a mix of chaos, discovery, and unforgettable moments as he celebrates one of the biggest nights of the year in a completely new environment.

programme.title: iShowSpeed's First Time In Grenada
programme.desc: IShowSpeed travels to Grenada for the first time, experiencing the culture, beauty, and energy of the Caribbean island. From exploring local communities and scenic landscapes to connecting with residents and embracing the island’s unique atmosphere, Speed immerses himself in everything Grenada has to offer. Blending adventure, discovery, and his signature chaos, the episode captures an unfiltered journey through one of the Caribbean’s most vibrant destinations.

programme.title: iShowSpeed's First Time In COTE D'IVOIRE
programme.desc: IShowSpeed travels to Ivory Coast for the first time, stepping into a vibrant culture filled with energy, music, and community. From exploring the streets and connecting with locals to experiencing everyday life and traditions, Speed immerses himself in everything the country has to offer. Blending curiosity, chaos, and real-time reactions, the episode captures an unfiltered journey through one of West Africa’s most dynamic destinations.

programme.desc: Roberta gets revenge on Mia by making Mia think he father died. Joaquín offers Tomás work running drugs. Mia and Roberta have a legitimate boxing match.

programme.title: Capítulo 68

programme.title: Capítulo 71

programme.title: Sortilegio
programme.desc: Alejandro returns home after a terrible accident to discover that he is married to Maria Jose, a poor, innocent girl who was deceived by Alejandro's brother Bruno. Bruno used Alejandro's name to marry Maria Jose, soon after he sent to kill his brother in hopes that Maria Jose would inherit Alejandro's fortune. But when Maria Jose arrives at the mansion she realizes that Bruno lied to her and used her. She is also scared when Alejandro is found alive and returns home. Doctors tell Alejandro that he suffers from memory loss but he is convinced he never met Maria Jose before and goes in search of the truth, but during this time and Maria Jose actually fall in love, while Bruno and Maura (Alejandro's ex-girlfriend) plot to break them up. Meanwhile, the brothers' mother Victoria has fallen in love with Fernando--Alejandro's best friend, so closer to his age than hers.

programme.title: Assembly Required with Stacey Abrams (Why Everyone Should Love Star Trek)
programme.desc: Happy Star Trek Day, to all those who celebrate! In honor of the show’s 60th anniversary, Stacey sits down with fellow super fan, actor, comedian, writer and host of the podcast Starter Trek, Tawny Newsome. They talk about their personal fan origin stories, what the show has taught them about both science and fiction, and why Star Trek’s legacy is so important to highlight in our current political climate. They also talk about the recent loss of two icons, Dolly Parton and Gloria Steinem.

programme.title: Lovett or Leave It (ICC You Next Tuesday)
programme.desc: Jon Ossoff lays into Pete Hegseth, Trump puts the squeeze on Canada, and Zohran Mamdani removes the welcome mat for Benjamin Netanyahu. This week, Brendan Hunt is at the top of his game, talking Ted Lasso, Jimothy, and the World Cup. Gregg Araki joins to talk about Gen X, Gen Z, and what happens when people are afraid of discomfort. And then we all get comfortable with our Second Thoughts.

programme.title: What a Day (A New GOP Scandal Erupts)
programme.desc:
Ohio Republican Rep. Max Miller is facing serious allegations of spousal and child abuse from his former wife, Emily Moreno. Miller has denied all of the allegations, and as of our recording on Tuesday, he’s shown no indications that he wants to resign from office – even as several Senate Republicans have said he should quit. But Miller is not the only House Republican under the microscope for bad behavior — something that isn’t making life any easier on House Speaker Mike Johnson just a few months before the midterms. For more, we spoke to Jake Sherman, co-founder of Punchbowl News.
And in headlines, the Senate Judiciary Committee votes to advance acting Attorney General Todd Blanche’s nomination, Michigan voters head to the polls, and the Iran war has reportedly almost eliminated the U.S. stockpile of long-range precision missiles.

programme.title: Runaway Country with Alex Wagner (Trump's Black Box Presidency)
programme.desc: Pete Hegseth wants a $1.5 trillion bump in Pentagon spending, and won’t say what it’s for. War in Iran reignites, and the Trump administration hides the number of injured American troops. Innocent people are killed by ICE, and the FBI is no longer allowed to investigate. Whenever there is conflict or scandal—whenever the facts threaten Donald Trump’s political agenda—the White House’s strategy is to keep the country in the dark. Alex is joined by two veterans, Paul Riekhoff, host of the Independent Americans podcast, and Rebecca Roberts from About Face: Veterans Against the War, to talk about how the senselessness and secrecy around the Iran War is sitting with members of the military. Then, she puts all the cover-ups into context with New York Times White House Correspondent Maggie Haberman, coauthor of Regime Change: Inside the Imperial Presidency of Donald Trump.

programme.title: Hysteria (The Many vs. The Money)
programme.desc: White House Correspondent April Ryan guest hosts with Erin to discuss Abdul El-Sayed’s win in Michigan, the latest in Republican Rep Max Miller’s snowballing awfulness, and Republicans' ongoing obsession with Dr. Fauci. Then friend of the show, Minnesota’s LT. Governor Peggy Flanagan stops by to discuss her run for the U.S. Senate, and her favorite foods at the Minnesota State Fair. They wrap up with a very petty edition of the sanity corner.

programme.title: Pod Save America (Abdul El-Sayed Wins in Michigan feat. Bernie Sanders)
programme.desc: Abdul El-Sayed wins Michigan's democratic Senate nomination, defeating Rep. Haley Stevens by one point after a heated campaign about the future of the Democratic party. Jon and Dan sit down for a bonus pod to talk about how El-Sayed overcame $60+ million in outside spending against him, make sense of the closer-than-expected results, and to preview the general election message against Mike Rogers, the Trump-endorsed Republican nominee. Then, Senator Bernie Sanders, who endorsed El-Sayd's campaign on the day of its launch, talks to Jon about the future of the progressive movement.

programme.title: Lovett or Leave It (Pirro Pressure)
programme.desc: John Cornyn and Tom Tillis roll over for the last time, Trump flips over Jeanine Pirro’s Reflecting Pool call, and RFK Jr turns over a new leaf (and eats it!) with a brand-new cooking show. This week, it’s Poorna Jagannathan to the rescue, as we talk HBO’s Lanterns, sex scenes after 50, and the weirdest DC superheroes of all time. Meanwhile, Eliot Glazer gets an A+ on our Terrible Gays Quiz, and we defend the indefensible with I Don’t Care, I Lovett It. Then we close out the evening with a leisurely lap of Second thoughts.

programme.title: The Winning Of Morticia Addams

programme.title: My Fair Cousin Itt
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: Morticia's Romance (Part 1)
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: Morticia's Romance (Part 2)
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: Morticia Meets Royalty
programme.desc: Romance seems close for Thing, the Addams right-hand-in-a-box, when Gomez's aunt arrives for a visit accompanied by Lady Fingers, her handmaiden. Thing enjoys the visit most because it gives him a chance to hold hands with one of his own kind.

programme.title: Gomez, The People's Choice

programme.title: Cousin Itt's Problem
programme.desc: During a welcome home party for Cousin Itt, Morticia notices that the diminutive guest of honor seems to be losing his hair. Uncle Fester experiments with his chemistry set to produce a concoction that grows hair and tries the remedy on Itt.

programme.title: Halloween, Addams Style
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: Morticia, The Writer
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it, he will lose her.

programme.title: Morticia, The Sculptress
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets, a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: Gomez, The Reluctant Lover
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: Feud In The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney, to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

Featuring Jay Pharoah, Arden Myrin, Adam Ray, Beth Stelling, Luke Null, JR De Guzman, Jeremiah Watkins, Josh Adam Meyers, and more, the show delivers original comedy songs and musical parodies about life, fame, and delusion.

programme.title: The Specials: A Message To You
programme.desc: This episode of Record On explores how The Specials emerged from late-1970s Britain amid political unrest, racial tension, and economic struggle. Through rare footage and new interviews with Lynval Golding, Horace Panter, Pauline Black, Rhoda Dakar, and Damon Albarn, the film examines how the band’s fusion of ska and punk became an anthem for unity. Following the passing of Terry Hall, the documentary reflects on The Specials’ lasting influence and their timeless call for social harmony.

programme.title: Daryl Palumbo on Artist Friendly
programme.desc: On this week's episode of Artist Friendly, Joel Madden sits down with Daryl Palumbo. Formed in 1993 by a then-teenage Palumbo and guitarist Justin Beck, Glassjaw became one of post-hardcore's most influential acts, known as much for their unpredictable, genre-defying sound as for the loyal following of musicians who cite them as an inspiration. In 2003, Palumbo launched a second project, Head Automatica, pairing his love of Britpop and hip-hop with producer Dan "The Automator" Nakamura for a sound entirely different from Glassjaw's — their debut, Decadence, charted on the Billboard 200 the following year. More than three decades after he and Beck first bonded over matching Anthrax and Bad Brains T-shirts at summer camp, Palumbo is still fronting both bands, with new Head Automatica material in the works. In conversation with Joel, Daryl opens up about the freedom he's always chased in his music, how fatherhood became the most grounding and fulfilling thing he's ever experienced, and the years of self-doubt and restlessness that shaped both his art and his sense of self along the way.

programme.desc: Kara and Scott deliver sharp takes on tech, business, politics—plus bold bets, banter, winners & losers.

programme.title: Comforting Truths About Human Nature
programme.desc: How can we truly understand ourselves? Most of us either ignore our emotions or overthink them, turning simple feelings into complex puzzles. So how do we navigate the minefield of emotion to grow and become better? Expect to learn where self-esteem really comes from, why criticism hurts so much, where imposter syndrome comes from and how to overcome it, if hustle culture is a modern phenomenon or is this something new, why we tend to intellectualise our emotions, why we have existential crisis’ and how to navigate them, why online dating is so miserable for so many people and much more…

programme.title: How to Treat Men Better
programme.desc: Are modern gender dynamics leaving men feeling ‘castrated’? While men are often blamed for today’s social problems, far less attention is given to how shifting expectations of women and relationships may also shape male identity. What role do women play in this dynamic—and how can it be improved? Expect to learn how important it is for women to seem impressed or giddy or appreciative of their partner, how women can appear more receptive or appreciative, why men are being emasculated by women, how women can stop castrating men and much more…

programme.title: How to Defeat Your Stress, Anxiety & Inaction
programme.desc: If motivation can’t be trusted, what should you rely on instead? Bestselling author and top podcaster Mel Robbins explains why discipline and emotional control are the real keys to success, and how to build the mindset needed to follow through when it counts. Expect to learn why we cling to control even when we know it makes us miserable and why we focus on things we can't control, how to better deal with the judgment of others, where self-compassion comes from, how to get a grip on your anxiety and ADHD, what ""Let Them"" theory means and how to employ it, where self-compassion actually comes from and much more...

programme.title: The Personal Pain of Country Music
programme.desc: Odds are, your favorite country song wasn’t written by the person singing it; it was probably written by HARDY (or someone in his writing circle, maybe). So how did a Mississippi country boy become one of Nashville’s most powerful behind-the-scenes writers and producers? Expect to learn what HARDY’s philosophy for his career and life is, what most people do not understand about how the Nashville scene works, how to balance the unique tension between being a songwriter and an artist, the story of the bus crash that almost killed HARDY, how to use vulnerability and turn it into a strength and much more…

programme.title: Uncertain About Your Relationship? You Need This…
programme.desc: How do you know if you’re with the right person — or if you're just telling yourself you are? If you’re questioning the relationship more than enjoying it, Matthew Hussey might have the clarity you need. So what does finding your person actually look like, and what signs should you pay attention to? Expect to learn how to know when it’s time to leave a relationship, the 5 questions to ask yourself if you’re unsure about your relationship, why people struggle so hard with letting others go, how women can best support their man and visa versa, how important attractiveness is to both men and women in a successful relationship, ways to learnt to be more vulnerable and much more…
